games.name: Cyber Nexus 2077
games.description: Dive into a sprawling neon-lit metropolis where every choice reshapes the world. Hack, fight, and forge alliances in a dystopian future.

games.name: Shadow Realm
games.description: Venture into cursed lands teeming with ancient horrors. Wield forbidden magic and uncover secrets buried beneath a dying world.

games.name: Stellar Odyssey
games.description: Chart unknown star systems, build your fleet, and make first contact with alien civilizations across a procedurally generated galaxy.

games.name: Neon Racers
games.description: Blaze through anti-gravity tracks at breakneck speeds. Customize your hovercraft and dominate the neon-soaked racing circuit.

games.name: Mythic Legends
games.description: Command legendary heroes, build mighty kingdoms, and wage epic wars in a richly crafted mythological world.

games.name: Zero Gravity
games.description: Manipulate gravity, bend space, and solve mind-bending puzzles across surreal dimensions in this award-winning platformer.
